changes: Uses SABnzbd server_stats.total as the exact persistent SAB lifetime byte counter and adds it to the preserved pre-SAB NewzDeck baseline.
Persists completed SAB statistics exactly once per NZO id in the shared cross-process ledger so service/desktop handoff and History clearing cannot double-count or erase lifetime totals.
Backfills retained SAB History and Archive in bounded pages to recover available download_time and downloaded-byte data for cumulative Transfer Time and weighted Average Speed.
Persists the highest observed transfer speed immediately so Peak Speed survives runtime restarts.
Adds Download Statistics provenance and timing-coverage diagnostics while preserving v3.6.23 Automation title matching and all earlier accepted production behavior.
regression_guards: Total Downloaded must not remain frozen at the legacy pre-SAB value once server_stats is available.
A completed SAB history record must be accounted exactly once even when multiple NewzDeck runtimes observe it.
Peak Speed must survive a fresh process restart.
Clearing completed SAB History after accounting must not reduce durable lifetime statistics.
Average Speed must use bytes whose transfer duration is known rather than the larger lifetime byte total when old timing data is unavailable.
v3.6.23 90 Day Fiancé / 90 Day Fiance matching remains intact.
v3.6.22 unresolved/obfuscated binary behavior and v3.6.20 authoritative SAB Queue/History behavior remain unchanged.
name: Durable Download Statistics
